name: @ethantang1024/pi-notify
description: Focus-aware desktop notifications and sounds for Pi coding agent. Fires on task completion, errors, and questions with DECSET 1004 terminal focus tracking and 100% reliable native OS delivery (Windows Shell NotifyIcon, Linux libnotify).
